newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India's November kerosene tender closes Oct 3.
newsitem.headline: India's November kerosene tender closes Oct 3.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp has issued a tender to buy November delivery superior kerosene cargoes, traders said on Friday.
The tender closes on October 3 and offers should be valid for two days.
The tender seeks 45,000-tonne cargoes for delivery to the Madras or Haldia on the east coast and 30,000-tonne cargoes for delivery to Bombay on the west coast.

In its last tender for October delivery, IOC bought 210,000 tonnes of kerosene at around $2.25-$2.30 per barrel over MidEast quotes on a cost-and-freight basis to the east coast, and a free-on-board Kuwait cargo at a 65-cent premium.
